runner: Qwen 3.8 Max Preview via pi agent
notes: Single self-contained HTML, canvas only. Full game: main menu (Play / Leaderboard), a 5x9 checkerboard lawn, a sun economy (falling sky sun + sunflowers), five seed packets (Sunflower, Peashooter, Snow Pea, Wall-nut, Cherry) each with cost and recharge cooldown, a 24-wave spawn schedule with halfway and final-wave banners, three zombie types (basic / cone / bucket) that walk and eat plants, per-row lawnmowers as a last-resort failsafe, a win/lose end screen with name entry, and a localStorage top-5 leaderboard. Verified headless in Edge: the menu plus 12 s of live play (planting, sun accrual, zombie spawn) ran with 0 console/runtime errors.
